name: Drake
current_role: Rapper/singer; co-founder of OVO Sound record label and OVO lifestyle brand
profile: Aubrey Drake Graham, born 1986 in Toronto, first gained fame as Jimmy Brooks on TV's Degrassi: The Next Generation before becoming one of the best-selling recording artists ever. His wealth comes from music, touring, OVO Sound/OVO apparel, endorsements and investments; he continues to release and tour.
interesting_fact: He began his career as a child actor, playing wheelchair-using basketball player Jimmy Brooks on Degrassi: The Next Generation (2001-2008) before releasing mixtapes.
deep_cut_fact: Having dropped out of high school to act on Degrassi, he went back and earned his high school diploma in 2012 at age 25, working with a tutor over about five months.
notes: Global celebrity; outreach realistically only via management/label (OVO Sound). Net worth figure (Wikidata 2019) is far below current estimates. Not an energy/data-center figure.
